title: Chapter 237: Return To Nanshan Collection
content:
Chapter 237: Return To Nanshan Collection

Wang Shuo came to the cavalry camp and summoned several main subordinates.

In the military tent, Wang Shuo looked at the members of the original swift scout team.

Li Weiguo and Li Baoguo were also transferred to military generals.

Expand the army again and make up for the establishment.

The command value of Ayubu and Gong Zheng is almost close to 40 points, and it is not a problem to command 400 people.

Gong Kai, Gong Ping, and Baili Liang are less, only more than 20 points.

But in order to attack Nanshanji next, the army must be expanded, and the number of people can only be supplemented first.

Wang Shuo directly appointed Ayubu, Gong Zheng, Gong Ping, Gong Kai, Li Jianguo, and Baili Liang as commanders.

Five hundred-man battalions form a column, and the highest commander of a column is appointed as the commander.

After more than ten days of accumulation, 50 tool soldiers can be swiped out from the material exchange office every day, plus the people who led the people to join the army and the horse bandit prisoners.

The Chiyan Army has reached nearly 2,600 people.

However, one third of them are still in reserve, and their loyalty has not yet reached the standard.

Wang Shuo asked all the commanders to step up training to prepare for the next battle.

At the same time, let Li Weiguo temporarily take charge of the training of archers, and Li Baoguo temporarily take charge of the training of shield soldiers.

Ayubu is responsible for the military upgrade of the entire territory.

After the arrangements were made, Wang Shuo asked Gong Zheng and Gu Liji to accompany him and set off for Nanshanji.

Before leaving, Wang Shuo thought about it and took Zou Yuanjie with him.

"After I leave, you must build the territory well. When I return, it will be the time for the Red Flame Army to go on the expedition."

Duan Wenxi and Ayubu nodded heavily.

Duan Wenxi actually wanted to go with him to see the excitement, but was rejected by Wang Shuo.

The territory must have one civil and one military person in charge, so that Wang Shuo can feel at ease.

In order not to attract attention, Wang Shuo did not bring too many followers, and only asked Gong Zheng to select 10 shield guards.

Along the way, the crowd galloped on horseback, and an hour later, they arrived at Nanshanji.

From a distance, Wang Shuo saw that Nanshanji was building fortifications.

Wang Shuo felt bad!

When Wang Shuo walked to the city gate, he found that the progress of the project was not fast. Most of the craftsmen were working slowly without putting in any effort.

There were even some workers who had to do a simple mud-mixing several times, and they had to stop to rest and recover their energy after working for a while.

It can be seen that most of the wages were not paid in place.

Wang Shuo walked into the city gate and the guards guarding the city questioned him.

This was very different from before.

When they came last time, they didn't care.

But the two level 60 guards did not embarrass Wang Shuo and others. After a simple registration, they gave each of them a temporary pass token and collected a gold coin from each person.

Wang Shuo was very surprised, but he didn't care because it was just some small money.

When he came to the street, a bustling atmosphere came to his face.

Since the refugees who did not join the village basically joined the nearby system town, the population of Nanshanji suddenly increased.

Wang Shuo walked around and even went to the entrance of the Iron Sword Gate and the Wild Wolf Gang.

The shops on the three streets of the whole town were open for business, and it looked very prosperous.

Finally, Wang Shuo came to Chef Zhang's Fuyue Restaurant again.

Walking into the hall, I saw several decorative paintings hanging on the walls around, and the shop assistants also changed into new clothes, which improved a lot of grade.

In the hall, there was a lot of noise, and many people were sitting, among which several tough-looking people were talking loudly.

"Congratulations, Brother Li, for successfully joining Mayor Lin's army. If you are going to be successful in the future, don't forget the friendship we had when we teamed up together to fight slimes!"

"Brothers, when I gain a foothold in the military camp, I will definitely find a way to help you brothers. I still remember that it was Brother Zhang who gave me a bottle of life potion so that I could survive. I will never forget this life-saving grace."

"Come on, come on, you and I are brothers, brothers for life, everything is in the wine."
